prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Pet's Quick Controls", "Practice hiding, summoning, and talking to your pet right on your desktop before finishing setup.", "Practice Control Commands"]
1: ["Your Pet is Coming to Life", "Watch traits assemble as your companion prepares to enter your desktop workspace."]
2: ["Welcome Your Desktop Companion", "Select your pet's desktop dock position and review quick interaction hotkeys.", "Desktop Hotkey Quick Setup"]
3: ["Find Your Ideal Experience Mode", "Compare immersive story progression with lightweight desktop companion mode.", "Explore Experience Modes"]
4: ["Custom Pet Creation Studio", "Upload clear photos to accurately generate your pet's visual style and unique markings.", "Photo Framing Guidelines"]
5: ["Sign In to Sync Your Pets", "Access your existing pet roster across devices or save your newly adopted pet securely.", "Cloud Pet Roster Protection"]
6: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Render Engine", "Your pet is initializing graphics and desktop tray integration."]
7: ["Interactive Desktop Sandbox", "Try feeding, moving, and minimizing your pet right now before finishing setup.", "Complete Onboarding"]
8: ["Finalizing Pet Adoption Record", "Confirming pet attributes and issuing official desktop registration badge.", "Official Pet Registration"]
9: ["Choose Your Pet Companion Experience", "Select Story Mode for narrative quests or Companion Mode for an ambient desktop pet."]
